notes: Phase 5 of Worker 14 (ATELIER) shipped on branch worker-14-atelier-p2-p6. Motion Choreography v2 layered on top of existing Upg.motion (W12/P6) without disturbing it. New CSS block (~110 lines): [data-magnet] with cubic-bezier(0,0,0.2,1) 240ms transition, [data-reveal] opacity+translateY pattern with IO threshold 0.05 + rootMargin -10%, [data-stagger] children with --stagger-delay var, .page.is-entering with atelierPageEnter @keyframes (spring 360ms), .u-cursor-glow with radial halo tracking --cx/--cy, prefers-reduced-motion guards forcing instant visibility. New IIFEs (~185 lines): Upg.choreo.{refresh,magnetize,reveal,stagger,cursorGlow} — magnet 18% strength × 80px range, dual IntersectionObservers (cached) for reveal+stagger; Upg.transition.{navigate,supports} — uses startViewTransition where available, .is-entering fallback animation, [data-page] click delegation that respects legacy inline onclick. AUGMENTED dashboard markup: 10 data-reveal cells (greet + 4 stat-tiles + 4 bento cells + dock), 3 data-stagger containers (#cath-skill-grid 60ms, #cath-activity-list 40ms, .dock-row 80ms), 6 data-magnet on dock-btns. CRITICAL: did NOT modify the .page baseline (display: none) — Phase 5 spec proposed `.page:not(.active) {position:absolute;visibility:hidden}` which would have broken layout; instead we kept legacy display:none and only animate via .is-entering class. Sacred preserved: 14 page sections, 391 qcalc, 17 nav-items, all prior Upg.* APIs untouched (now 18 total: theme,icons,gateway,calc,cmdk,state,production,type,scroll,nav,identity,greet,countup,motion,material,chrome,choreo,transition).
